critic.rationale: Accept. Both edits are semantic refinements of generic memory rules: they preserve the nonbinding advisor interface, actor authority, native archival update, public-evidence constraints, abstention, receipt correlation, partial completion, continuation authorization, and unresolved conflicts. They do not add concrete task answers or identities, evaluator access, mandatory overrides, fabricated facts, or new runtime tools. The guidance patch clarifies distinct authorization/trigger/receipt dimensions and abstention; the update patch preserves live obligation status and receipt extent while compacting history, without converting memory into instructions or imposing restrictions.
